INSERT INTO public.bc_resource
(company_name, code, name, email, department_code, calendar_type,
 fecha_de_baja, fecha_de_alta, subcontratacion, perfil,
 last_modified_datetime, updated_at)
SELECT
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  NULLIF(btrim($4),''),
  NULLIF(btrim($5),''),
  $6,
  NULLIF(NULLIF($7::text,''),'0001-01-01')::date,
  NULLIF(NULLIF($8::text,''),'0001-01-01')::date,
  CASE WHEN $9::text IN ('true','1','t','yes') THEN true ELSE false END,
  $10,
  NULLIF($11::text,'')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
WHERE $2::text <> ''
  AND btrim(coalesce($4,'')) <> ''
  AND position('@' in btrim(coalesce($4,''))) > 0
  AND btrim(coalesce($5,'')) <> ''
ON CONFLICT (code, company_name)
DO UPDATE SET
  name                   = EXCLUDED.name,
  email                  = EXCLUDED.email,
  department_code        = EXCLUDED.department_code,
  calendar_type          = EXCLUDED.calendar_type,
  fecha_de_baja          = EXCLUDED.fecha_de_baja,
  fecha_de_alta          = EXCLUDED.fecha_de_alta,
  subcontratacion        = EXCLUDED.subcontratacion,
  perfil                 = EXCLUDED.perfil,
  last_modified_datetime = EXCLUDED.last_modified_datetime,
  updated_at             = NOW()
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.bc_ps_year
(company_name, ps_year)
SELECT
  $1,                 -- company_name
  $2::integer         -- ps_year
WHERE $2::text <> '' AND $2::text != '0'      -- ps_year obligatorio y válido
ON CONFLICT (ps_year)
DO UPDATE SET
  company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.bc_job
(company_name, no, description, departamento, probability, tipo_proyecto, status, fecha_fin, do_not_consolidate, responsible, last_modified_datetime, updated_at)
SELECT
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  CASE
    WHEN $5::text ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN $5::numeric
    ELSE 0::numeric
  END,
  $6,
  $7,
  NULLIF(NULLIF($8::text,''),'0001-01-01')::date,
  CASE WHEN $9::text IN ('true','1','t','yes') THEN true ELSE false END,
  $10,
  NULLIF($11::text,'')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
WHERE $2::text <> ''
  AND btrim(coalesce($3,'')) <> ''
  AND btrim(coalesce($4,'')) <> ''
  AND btrim(coalesce($7,'')) <> ''
ON CONFLICT (company_name, no)
DO UPDATE SET
  description            = EXCLUDED.description,
  departamento           = EXCLUDED.departamento,
  probability            = EXCLUDED.probability,
  tipo_proyecto          = EXCLUDED.tipo_proyecto,
  status                 = EXCLUDED.status,
  fecha_fin              = EXCLUDED.fecha_fin,
  do_not_consolidate     = EXCLUDED.do_not_consolidate,
  responsible            = EXCLUDED.responsible,
  last_modified_datetime = EXCLUDED.last_modified_datetime,
  updated_at             = NOW()
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO public.bc_job_team (company_name, job_no, resource_no, resource_name, updated_at)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, NULLIF(btrim($4), ''), NOW()
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_job j WHERE j.company_name = $1 AND j.no = $2)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_resource r WHERE r.company_name = $1 AND r.code = $3)
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT job_team_pkey
DO UPDATE SET
  resource_name = EXCLUDED.resource_name,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_job j WHERE j.company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name AND j.no = EXCLUDED.job_no)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_resource r WHERE r.company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name AND r.code = EXCLUDED.resource_no)
RETURNING *;

WITH partitions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS p(year integer, month integer)
),
deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month t
  WHERE $4::boolean
    AND t.company_name = $1
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM partitions p
      WHERE p.year = t.year AND p.month = t.month
    )
  RETURNING 1
),
src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r(
    job_no text,
    year integer,
    month integer,
    nr text,
    type_line text,
    line_type text,
    concepto_analitico_descripcion text,
    document_no text,
    document_date text,
    timesheet_date text,
    invoice numeric,
    cost numeric,
    quantity numeric,
    departamento text,
    description text,
    status text,
    tipo_proyecto text,
    probability numeric,
    do_not_consolidate boolean,
    budget_date_year integer,
    budget_date_month integer,
    month_closing_status text,
    concepto_analitico_code text
  )
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month
  (company_name, job_no, year, month, nr, type_line, line_type, concepto_analitico_descripcion, document_no,
   document_date, timesheet_date, invoice, cost, quantity, departamento, description, status, tipo_proyecto,
   probability, do_not_consolidate, budget_date_year, budget_date_month, month_closing_status, concepto_analitico_code, updated_at)
  SELECT
    $1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.job_no, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(src.year, 0),
    COALESCE(src.month, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.nr, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.type_line, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.line_type, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.concepto_analitico_descripcion, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(src.document_no, ''), ''),
    NULLIF(NULLIF(src.document_date, ''), '0001-01-01')::date,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(src.timesheet_date, ''), '0001-01-01')::date,
    src.invoice,
    src.cost,
    src.quantity,
    NULLIF(src.departamento, ''),
    NULLIF(src.description, ''),
    NULLIF(src.status, ''),
    NULLIF(src.tipo_proyecto, ''),
    src.probability,
    COALESCE(src.do_not_consolidate, false),
    src.budget_date_year,
    src.budget_date_month,
    NULLIF(src.month_closing_status, ''),
    NULLIF(src.concepto_analitico_code, ''),
    NOW()
  FROM src
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(src.job_no, ''), '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(src.year, 0) <> 0
    AND COALESCE(src.month, 0) <> 0
  ON CONFLICT (company_name, job_no, year, month, nr, type_line, line_type, concepto_analitico_descripcion, document_no) DO UPDATE SET
    document_date = EXCLUDED.document_date,
    timesheet_date = EXCLUDED.timesheet_date,
    invoice = EXCLUDED.invoice,
    cost = EXCLUDED.cost,
    quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity,
    departamento = EXCLUDED.departamento,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    tipo_proyecto = EXCLUDED.tipo_proyecto,
    probability = EXCLUDED.probability,
    do_not_consolidate = EXCLUDED.do_not_consolidate,
    budget_date_year = EXCLUDED.budget_date_year,
    budget_date_month = EXCLUDED.budget_date_month,
    month_closing_status = EXCLUDED.month_closing_status,
    concepto_analitico_code = EXCLUDED.concepto_analitico_code,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM deleted) AS deleted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM upserted) AS affected;

UPDATE public.sync_state
SET last_sync_at = $2::timestamptz
WHERE company_name = $1 AND entity = 'bc_job_ledger_entry_month'
RETURNING *;

WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r(
    job_no text,
    year integer,
    month integer,
    nr text,
    type_line text,
    line_type text,
    concepto_analitico_descripcion text,
    document_no text,
    document_date text,
    timesheet_date text,
    invoice numeric,
    cost numeric,
    quantity numeric,
    departamento text,
    description text,
    status text,
    tipo_proyecto text,
    probability numeric,
    do_not_consolidate boolean,
    budget_date_year integer,
    budget_date_month integer,
    month_closing_status text,
    concepto_analitico_code text
  )
),
open_only AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM src s
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(s.job_no, ''), '') <> ''
    AND COALESCE(s.year, 0) <> 0
    AND COALESCE(s.month, 0) <> 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_meses_cerrados c
      WHERE c.company_name = $1
        AND c.job_no = s.job_no
        AND c.year = s.year
        AND c.month = s.month
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month t
      WHERE t.company_name = $1
        AND t.job_no = s.job_no
        AND t.year = s.year
        AND t.month = s.month
        AND t.concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'
        AND COALESCE(t.month_closing_status, '') = 'Close'
        AND (
          (
            t.nr = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.nr, ''), '')
            AND t.type_line = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.type_line, ''), '')
            AND t.line_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.line_type, ''), '')
            AND t.concepto_analitico_descripcion = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.concepto_analitico_descripcion, ''), '')
            AND t.document_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(s.document_no, ''), '')
          )
          OR (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(s.document_no, ''), '') <> ''
            AND t.document_no = s.document_no
          )
        )
    )
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month
  (company_name, job_no, year, month, nr, type_line, line_type, concepto_analitico_descripcion, document_no,
   document_date, timesheet_date, invoice, cost, quantity, departamento, description, status, tipo_proyecto,
   probability, do_not_consolidate, budget_date_year, budget_date_month, month_closing_status, concepto_analitico_code, updated_at)
  SELECT
    $1,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.job_no, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(open_only.year, 0),
    COALESCE(open_only.month, 0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.nr, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.type_line, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.line_type, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.concepto_analitico_descripcion, ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(open_only.document_no, ''), ''),
    NULLIF(NULLIF(open_only.document_date, ''), '0001-01-01')::date,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(open_only.timesheet_date, ''), '0001-01-01')::date,
    open_only.invoice,
    open_only.cost,
    open_only.quantity,
    NULLIF(open_only.departamento, ''),
    NULLIF(open_only.description, ''),
    NULLIF(open_only.status, ''),
    NULLIF(open_only.tipo_proyecto, ''),
    open_only.probability,
    COALESCE(open_only.do_not_consolidate, false),
    open_only.budget_date_year,
    open_only.budget_date_month,
    NULLIF(open_only.month_closing_status, ''),
    NULLIF(open_only.concepto_analitico_code, ''),
    NOW()
  FROM open_only
  ON CONFLICT (company_name, job_no, year, month, nr, type_line, line_type, concepto_analitico_descripcion, document_no)
  DO UPDATE SET
    document_date = EXCLUDED.document_date,
    timesheet_date = EXCLUDED.timesheet_date,
    invoice = EXCLUDED.invoice,
    cost = EXCLUDED.cost,
    quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity,
    departamento = EXCLUDED.departamento,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    tipo_proyecto = EXCLUDED.tipo_proyecto,
    probability = EXCLUDED.probability,
    do_not_consolidate = EXCLUDED.do_not_consolidate,
    budget_date_year = EXCLUDED.budget_date_year,
    budget_date_month = EXCLUDED.budget_date_month,
    month_closing_status = EXCLUDED.month_closing_status,
    concepto_analitico_code = EXCLUDED.concepto_analitico_code,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING 1
),
pruned_dup AS (
  DELETE FROM public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month t
  WHERE t.company_name = $1
    AND t.concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'
    AND COALESCE(t.month_closing_status, '') = 'Open'
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_meses_cerrados c
        WHERE c.company_name = $1
          AND c.job_no = t.job_no
          AND c.year = t.year
          AND c.month = t.month
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.bc_job_ledger_entry_month c
        WHERE c.company_name = t.company_name
          AND c.job_no = t.job_no
          AND c.year = t.year
          AND c.month = t.month
          AND c.concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'
          AND COALESCE(c.month_closing_status, '') = 'Close'
          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.document_no, ''), '') <> ''

    )
